verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents scheduled tasks that run on a recurring cron schedule, including examples like 9.30am every other Monday, and a community user reports the scheduled task feature 'just works'. Nothing in the evidence shows timezone control, which is an explicit part of the story. Missing for 10: documented timezone configuration for schedules, details on how schedules are managed (dashboard or declarative/imperative).

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run workflows on cron-style schedules with timezone control

citations.quote: A task that is triggered on a recurring schedule using cron syntax.
Use schedules for recurring tasks, like a cron job every 5 minutes, a task that runs at 9.30am every other Monday
The scheduled task feature has been a lifesaver—super simple and just works exactly as expected.
